video.desc: My exact 10-day itinerary for the North Island of New Zealand ✨🏔️🌿 Comment “North Island” and I’ll send you my full detailed itinerary, including meals and hotels!  New Zealand is one of the most magical countries I’ve ever been to. It has the perfect combination of dramatic mountains, tropical beaches, serenely beautiful lakes and otherworldly landscapes (the geothermal activity is stunning)!  We loved renting a car and driving here - it’s the best way to enjoy the beauty of NZ at your own pace! The diverse regions are all within just a few hours of each other, so it’s easy to get around via car. We traveled here with @United Airlines and @Air New Zealand ch made the trip from California comfortable & easy ✈️ Here are the IG handles/business names for the activities I mention in this video: Mountain biking:  Mountain Bike Rotarua FourB New Zealand  Spas/thermal pools: @Secret Spot Hot Tubs  Wairakei Terraces Bungy jumping & speed boat: @Hukafalls Jet | Jet Boating  @AJ Hackett Bungy NZ  Natural sights: Orakei Koraka Redwoods Treewalk Māori harvest celebration: @TePāTū  —- @Purenewzealand  #unitedpartner #airnewzealandpartner #pureNZ
